entities.summary: Gela Dumbadze is a Georgian diplomat. He is serving as Ambassador Extraordinary and Plenipotentiary of Georgia to Ukraine since June 15, 2017. He was the State Minister of Georgia for Diaspora Issues from 2014 to 2016.
